en_US: Baoba: It is you!
It must have been a long way.
Welcome to the Safari Zone!
It hasn’t been open too long, but you
can enjoy all the fun!
Please feel free to enjoy my safari!
Baoba: I will keep upgrading my safari.
I will let you know using Pokégear if I
make any changes.
Safari Zone...
It makes me feel like I am in a
foreign country.
It brings up a strange feeling.
(I am not a talker.)
This Safari Zone is great!
I just kept going after Pokémon!
That made my JIGGLYPUFF upset though.
Safari, safari,
it is so much fun.
Safari, safari,
so interesting, huh!
So many Pokémon are waiting for us!
...That’s a song I made up.
I sing it when I am in the Safari Zone.
Airily goes the Safari Ball under the
blue sky. Sprinkly goes your sweat to
celebrate a friendship.
I love the Safari Zone!
...I made a whole jingle out of it.
You think anyone would be interested?
I’ve decided to carry Pokémon drinks.
This will be new to me, but I will do
my best...
Oh, you want to buy something?
Can you wait while I get it ready?
Just a minute...
There are many Pokémon to choose from,
but nothing beats the cuteness of
SLOWPOKE.
People often say that I look like one!
I have always wanted to catch my first
Pokémon at the Safari Zone.
You may be under the impression
there is a sophisticated system to
customizing the Safari Zone, right?
The real truth is that...
Arrrgh...
I am so exhausted...
This job uses so much of your energy...
Safari Zone
This is where everything is thrilling.
Feel free to come by and experience
the wild!
